[USER] The user is especially interested in vegan granola bars and wants recipes using rolled oats and nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided three vegan granola bar recipes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Recipe 1: Classic Oat and Nut Granola Bars**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats, 1 cup chopped nuts, 1/2 cup dried fruit, 1/4 cup nut butter, 1/4 cup honey or maple syrup, 1/4 cup chia seeds, pinch of salt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions: Combine dry ingredients, mix wet ingredients, combine, press into a dish
